messages.subject: output exifTagNames ( )
parts:
Hi,

Why the output of exifTagNames(inDir = directory_images_renamed, returnMetadata = F) looks different from exifTagNames(inDir = directory_images_renamed, returnMetadata = T)?

Has anyone seen this?

Thanks a lot.

Angela

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: output exifTagNames ( )
parts:
Yes, this is normal and expected, but can be confusing.

exifTagNames(..., returnMetadata = T) returns the contents of metadata tags. This is to assess which metadata tags are relevant, as they may partly be manufacturer-specific.The names of the metadata tags are different from the ones returned when exifTagNames(..., returnMetadata = F). In the former, they may contain spaces etc., but not in the latter. Use the metadata tag names returned by exifTagNames(..., returnMetadata = F) in the record table functions (in the additionalMetadataTags argument).

Please also have a look here in the vignette:
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/camtrapR/vignettes/DataExtraction.html#extracting-image-metadata
